description: This file defines the RateLimiter class within the AWS SDK for PHP, implementing rate limiting logic with token buckets and cubic throttle algorithms.

classes.name: RateLimiter
classes.description: A class that manages request rate limiting using token bucket and cubic algorithms, with configurable options for fine-tuning.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the RateLimiter with optional configuration parameters.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the rate limiter is enabled.

methods.name: getSendToken
methods.description: Requests a token to send a request; internally calls acquireToken.

methods.name: updateSendingRate
methods.description: Updates the sending rate based on whether requests are throttled, returning the new rate.

methods.name: acquireToken
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a token for sending a request, refilling the token bucket as needed.

methods.name: calculateTimeWindow
methods.description: Calculates the time window used for cubic throttle adjustments.

methods.name: cubicSuccess
methods.description: Calculates the rate after a successful transmission based on cubic growth.

methods.name: cubicThrottle
methods.description: Calculates the throttled rate based on cubic function.

methods.name: enableTokenBucket
methods.description: Enables the token bucket, allowing token acquisition.

methods.name: refillTokenBucket
methods.description: Refills tokens in the token bucket based on elapsed time.

methods.name: time
methods.description: Returns the current time, using either a custom provider or microtime.

methods.name: updateMeasuredRate
methods.description: Updates the measured transmission rate based on recent requests.

methods.name: updateTokenBucketRate
methods.description: Sets the token bucket fill rate and capacity based on new requests per second.
